note: The CFF2 Top DICT bytes from the input font are loaded as the dictionary buffer parsed by the CFF parser.
The input-controlled maxstack operator value is decoded from the CFF2 Top DICT and stored in the top font dictionary.
For CFF2 private dictionaries the parser stack is sized to maxstack without reserving an additional entry for the operator pointer that cff_parser_run stores.
The undersized stackSize controls the heap allocation for parser->stack.
When a CFF2 private dictionary reaches an operator after maxstack operands, the code writes the operator pointer at parser->top past the allocated stack.
